Danish vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 September, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:150396
Court No. - 80
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 30844 of 2024
Applicant :- Danish
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Faizan Siddiqui,Mohd Sakib,Mohd Shaban Ahmad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings as well as impugned charge sheet dated 13.08.2015 alongwith the cognizance order dated 17.02.2016 in Criminal Case No.78 of 2016, titled as State v. Danish, arising out of Case Crime No.103 of 2015, under Sections 420, 406 I.P.C., registered at P.S. Sambhal, District Sambhal,
pending before Civil Judge (J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Sambhal.
3. As per prosecution's case, the applicant has extracted money from many persons including the informant in the name of providing job in abroad.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that; the applicant is a student and he is pursuing his education in London American City College (FZC) situated in United Arab Emirates and he has been falsely implicated in the instant case; the allegations levelled against the applicant in the FIR are false and baseless; the applicant alongwith his father had some business relations with the Danish vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4735208/
1 complainant and he has no concern with the alleged forgery; the entire prosecution story is absolutely false and concocted and the allegations made against the applicant is nothing but to grab the undue advantage; no direct evidence has come against the applicant.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer made in the application and submits that there are serious allegations of undue gain by causing illegal loss to numerous job seekers in abroad,
therefore, no case for quashing of the entire proceedings is made out.
6. In the instant matter, the submissions raised by learned counsel for the applicant call for determination on questions of fact which may be adequately adjudicated upon only by the trial court.
Adjudication of questions of facts and appreciation of evidence or examining the reliability and credibility of the version, does not fall within the arena of jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

In view of the material on record it can also not be held that the impugned criminal proceeding are manifestly attended with mala fide and maliciously instituted with an ulterior motive for wreaking vengeance on the accused and with a view to spite him due to private and personal grudge.

Similarly no such illegality, perversity or any other substantial error could be pointed out in the impugned summoning order, so as to warrant any interference by this court in exercise of powers u/s 482 CrPC.
7.

After hearing learned counsel for the applicant and having gone through the material available on record, its prima facie observed that the applicant has caused illegal loss to many innocent persons in the name of providing them job in abroad, the ingredients of Sections 420, 406 I.P.C., satisfied therefore, no prima facie case for quashing of the impugned order and proceedings is made out.
8. The application is devoid of merits, and it is accordingly dismissed.
